rows.ARS: White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Rosen-Tantau (Germany, 2002).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2006 as 'Green Tea'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Pale yellow-green. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea, high-centered bloom form.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or exhibition.
rows.Notes: See COMMENTS for parentage information source.

colour: White or white blend. Pale yellow-green.
